Powders of titanium alloyed with 48 at %Al (Ti-48Al)

the harmonic-structured composite with pure titanium (Ti) and Ti-48 at%Al alloy (Ti-48Al) were fabricated by the combination of the mechanical milling (MM) and the spark plasma sintering (SPS) process.
commercially pure titanium (Ti; 99.9 mass % purity) were used in this study
First, to obtain a fine Ti-48Al powder, mechanical milling was performed at a ball-to-powder weight ratio of 3 : 1 and an MM time of 54 ks.
Next, a mixture of pure Ti powder and Ti-48Al (11.1 to 20.0 mass % ) MM powder was mechanically milled at a ball-to-powder weight ratio of 2 : 1 and an MM time of 36 ks.
The composite MM powder containing Ti-48Al and pure Ti was sintered using SPS apparatus (SPS-510L; Sumitomo Coal Mining Co., Ltd.) at 1073 K and 50 MPa for 1.8 ks.

However, some crack propagation was prevented by the dispersed region, as indicated by the arrows in Fig. 8. Therefore, the harmonic-structured composite can deform without a rapid fracture.
Advanced ductility of the harmonic-structured materials is attributed to the obstruction of crack propagation by the dispersed region.
The harmonic-structured composite demonstrates high strength and sufficient ductility compared with the conventional compact consisting of only Ti-48Al.
As a result, the harmonic-structured composites with Ti-48Al (12.5 and 14.3 mass %) indicate high strength and high elongation compared with the conventional Ti-48Al compact.
